intent: Every interactive python_pkg CLI ends its --help on kuhy's shared logo credit line (Created by kuhy https://kuhy.duckdns.org). testsAndMisc holds no GUI, web app or game, so --help is the only place the credit can go here.
scope: python_pkg: android_ui (cli, workout_firebase_flow), app_icons, archwiki_rag, artgate, code_tutor, js_anki, morning_routine, phone_lease, random_jpg, sql_drills, vscode_optimizer
No change to kuhyx/utils: credit_line() already covers terminal programs
changes: argparse parsers take epilog=credit_line(); code_tutor's typer.Typer takes epilog=credit_line()
kuhy-credit pinned at v0.3.1 (newest tag) in meta/requirements.txt, meta/requirements-test.txt and the pylint hook env
test_cli_credit.py runs each CLI as python -m <module> --help in a subprocess (12 modules)
morning_routine/install.sh pip-installs the requirements.txt pin into /usr/bin/python's user site, since its unit runs the system interpreter
Flutter pin 3.50.0 -> 3.50.1; stale Python pins bumped (anthropic 2.12.0, coverage 7.17.4, fastmcp 4.2.4, hypothesis 6.170.17)
pylint hook: rev v4.1.4, --jobs=1 (dill breaks on 3.15), unused pygame/python-chess deps dropped
excluded: android_ui/mcp_server.py: stdio JSON-RPC, extra stdout breaks the protocol
live_calc/calc_eval.py: called per keystroke by the zsh widget; output is the result
brother_printer, wallpaper_rotator, phone_guard, endurain_import, archwiki_rag/_reindex_entry: no argparse, daemons or status producers whose stdout other programs read

linux_configuration/*.py: monitor_autoconfig (background watcher), g29_shifter_capture (root BPF diagnostic), verify_helium / migrate_helium (installer steps), transcribe_fw/helpers (run in their own venv without kuhy-credit) - system tooling, not apps
GUIs/games: git grep for gatelock|tkinter|pygame|godot outside docs hits only package lists and lint configs; no *.desktop, project.godot or pubspec.yaml is tracked

verification.evidence: red first: 7 failed, 5 passed; after the change: 12 passed
the install.sh step exits 0 with the v0.3.1 pin

risks: morning_routine now imports a third-party package under /usr/bin/python; a fresh machine needs install.sh rerun
